The '''Emperor's Royal Guard stormtrooper armor''' was a model of [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] used by the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]]. While it was otherwise similar to regular [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] in appearance, the only difference was that it was [[Color/Legends|red]]. The color echoed the standard uniform of the Emperor's Royal Guard. Two [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of Royal Guard donning this armor were given to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] by [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Imperial Intelligence Director]] [[Ysanne Isard]].<ref name="Lumiya: Dark Star of the Empire" />
